title: Termination of a Kessler GAP Waiver after Loan Payoff
content:
# Termination of a Kessler GAP Waiver after Loan Payoff

Lender-payoff processing reference, Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda.

## Scope

This policy prices the termination refund booked when an active waiver whose loan the lienholder has reported paid off or refinanced away is terminated. An active waiver that carries a submitted signed cancellation request recorded for it ends by the holder's cancellation, whether or not its lienholder has reported a loan payoff date; an active waiver with a loan payoff date on file and no submitted signed cancellation request ends by termination.

For a termination priced under this policy, and only for such a termination, the waiver is terminated and its refund computed without any request where the waiver's tier computes payoff refunds automatically, and the termination takes the effective date the termination rules of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda fix. A waiver that carries a submitted signed cancellation request is not terminated in this way and ends by the holder's cancellation. A waiver with no loan payoff date on file is not terminated under this policy either.

## Effect

Terminating moves the waiver to terminated status with the effective date of the termination as its closing date, books a refund calculation entry for the termination refund and its refund basis on the waiver's ledger dated on that effective date, and raises the waiver's refund due by that amount. The holder can see the terminated waiver and the refund due on it.

## Invocation

The agent unlocks the agent-side tool `terminate_paid_off_waiver_88a68523` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `gap_waiver_id` — reference number of the GAP waiver being terminated, as returned by the GAP waiver lookup (Id).
- `effective_date` — the date the termination takes effect, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone); it becomes the waiver's closing date and the date of the refund calculation entry.
- `cancel_method` — the basis of the termination refund, exactly one of: `pro_rata` (the refund is the unused part of the term); `flat_deal_unwound` (the waiver's purchase deal was unwound and the full price comes back); `flat_free_look` (refused: a free-look refund belongs to a holder's cancellation, never to a termination); `not_applicable` (refused: reserved for ledger entries that are not refund calculations).
- `refund_amount` — the termination refund owed, in US dollars, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (a half cent goes up); 0.00 when no refund is owed.

**Return.** On success one line: "Waiver <gap_waiver_id> terminated effective <effective_date>; refund calculation <entry id> booked for <amount> USD (<cancel_method>); refund due now <due> USD." The entry id is the new refund calculation entry's reference number; the amount and the refund due are shown with 2 decimals. Receiving this line means the termination and its refund calculation are recorded.

A line starting "Error:" means nothing was written. It is returned when the waiver carries no loan payoff date reported by its lienholder, when it carries a cancellation request in submitted status, when the date is not a real calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, when the refund basis is not `pro_rata` or `flat_deal_unwound`, or when the amount is negative.
